frames.title: Lesson 128 · Subjunctive constructions — production and review

body: **Foco:** Subjunctive constructions — produção e revisão.
**Pronúncia:** Pausas e ritmo.
**22 palavras novas** (problemas sociais).
**Texto do dia:** blog, diário, crônica.

blocks.t: **Objetivo de comunicação (C1):** eu consigo produzir um blog com subjuntivo (suggest that, essential that, if I were) e revisar a forma.

body: Esta aula treina **ouvir e anotar informações (IELTS Listening, TOEFL Listening)**.

blocks.t: Toque em 🔊, ouça e repita cada palavra. Depois tente adivinhar o sentido.

blocks.title: Blog: If I Were the Mayor
paras: **If I were** the mayor, I would **demand that** every new building **include** affordable flats. I would **insist that** rents **be** published and **recommend that** landlords **not** raise prices by more than 5%.

**It is vital that** young people **have** a voice. **I suggest that** the council **create** a youth board, and **I propose that** it **meet** monthly. **I wish** the debate **were** less political and more practical. But, **were I** in charge, I would start with one rule: **be** honest with residents.

items.q: The writer would raise rents by 5%.
items.why: not raise prices by more than 5%.

items.q: The writer wants a youth board.
The writer is already the mayor.

blocks.body: Revise: o verbo depois de **that** está na **forma base**? O negativo usa **not + base** (sem *do*)?
✗ *I suggest that he doesn’t go.* ✓ *I suggest that he not go.*

items.s: I demand that every flat ___ affordable. (be)
I recommend that landlords ___ raise prices. (not)

blocks.title: Match the word to its meaning

body: **Were I in your position,…** — Se eu estivesse no seu lugar,…
**If need be,…** — Se for preciso,…
**Come what may** — Aconteça o que acontecer
**Be that as it may** — Seja como for
**Far be it from me to…** — Longe de mim…
**God forbid** — Deus me livre
**So be it.** — Que seja.
**Long live…** — Vida longa a…
**And rents?** — E os aluguéis?
**What would you do if you were mayor?** — O que você faria se fosse prefeito?
**I would demand that every building include affordable flats.** — Eu exigiria que cada prédio incluísse apartamentos acessíveis.

blocks.title: Debate club
lines: What would you do if you were mayor?
O que você faria se fosse prefeito?
I would demand that every building include affordable flats.
Eu exigiria que cada prédio incluísse apartamentos acessíveis.
I recommend that rents be published every year.
Recomendo que os aluguéis sejam publicados todo ano.

items.label: Pausas e ritmo
items.note: Expressividade: varie altura, volume e velocidade para mostrar atitude; uma voz monótona soa desinteressada, mesmo com boas palavras.
words: That is NOT what I meant.

prompts.q: Make a demand with the subjunctive.
prompts.model: I demand that the budget be public.
If I were in charge, I would listen first.
I recommend that landlords not raise rents.

blocks.task: Write a blog paragraph of 7 sentences titled “If I were…”, using at least four subjunctive structures.
blocks.model: If I were the head of a school, I would insist that every student have a mentor. I would demand that classes start later. I recommend that homework not exceed one hour. It is essential that teachers be trained in listening. I wish exams were less stressful. Were I in charge, I would ask students for their opinions.

body: Treine esta habilidade com o formato de tarefas curtas das provas (TOEFL/IELTS).
Leia o enunciado primeiro e procure as palavras-chave.
Use exemplos reais da vida dos alunos e peça frases próprias.
Corrija o erro mais frequente da aula em grupo, sem expor o aluno.
Retome o conteúdo na aula seguinte com um exercício curto.
